value.rationale: The structural failure of ergodicity in a model admitting a full-support Gibbs invariant distribution has physical implications for traffic transport. An exact density threshold and exponential frozen census coexist with explicit positive-current sectors at the same conserved filling, establishing initial-condition-dependent macroscopic transport invisible to an unconditional Gibbs current.
